Engine lubricant is primarily obtained from [[fractioning|Fractioning Tower]] [[industrial oil|Industrial Oil]]. It can be used to produce [[parrafin wax|Parrafin Wax]] which allows for early production of [[high-performance solvent|High-Performance Solvent]] or the production of [[petroil|Petroil]]. It is also required to lubricate the [[combined cycle gas turbine|Combined Cycle Gas Turbine]].
